rules.title: 200% text resize
rules.rule: All content and controls survive 200% text resize.

rules.title: Numbers align end
rules.rule: Numbers in tables are text-align: end; text is start.

rules.title: min-height for text boxes
rules.rule: Boxes holding text use min-height (or max-height with overflow auto), never a fixed height.

rules.title: Tracks can shrink
rules.rule: Grid tracks with long content use minmax(0, 1fr) and flex children min-width: 0.

rules.title: Text can grow
rules.rule: Labels and buttons have no fixed widths and rows wrap, so longer strings fit.

rules.title: Three font families at most
rules.rule: Use at most three font families; fewer is better.

rules.title: Weight floor
rules.rule: Below 18px use weight 400 or heavier; weights 100-300 only at 28px and up.
rules.notes: Read from the same computed-font inventory as R-min-font.

rules.title: No synthesized faces
rules.rule: Load every weight and style the design uses so the browser never synthesizes one.
rules.notes: Issue 14 suggests font-synthesis: none; the skill forbids it globally (see typo-no-global-synthesis-none). Skill wins.

rules.title: No global font-synthesis: none
rules.rule: Never set font-synthesis: none on body or interface text.

rules.title: Properties over feature tags
rules.rule: Use font-weight and font-variant-* where a property exists, not font-variation-settings or font-feature-settings.

rules.title: Small type scale
rules.rule: Use a small type scale, each size paired with its line-height and weight, with few sizes and weights in use.

rules.title: Headings descend
rules.rule: Heading sizes descend with level and a heading is never smaller than body text.

rules.title: Unitless line-height
rules.rule: line-height is unitless.
rules.notes: DS line-height.code (21px) and line-height.row (28px) are px on purpose: they set row heights. They are exempt.

rules.title: Line height by role
rules.rule: Display 1.1, headings 1.2-1.3, body 1.5-1.6.
rules.notes: DS line-height.reading is 1.5, on the floor.

rules.title: Wrapping text leading
rules.rule: Text that wraps to three or more lines has line-height 1.4 or more.

rules.title: Letter spacing by size
rules.rule: Headings 24px+ take -0.01em to -0.02em, uppercase labels 14px and under take about 0.05em, body stays 0.
rules.notes: DS uppercase labels use letter-spacing.micro and micro-wide, both 0.05em.

rules.title: Letter spacing in em
rules.rule: letter-spacing is set in em, not px.

rules.title: Kerning on
rules.rule: Never set font-kerning: none.

rules.title: Line length
rules.rule: Long-form text is capped at 60-75 characters per line.
rules.notes: DS layout.lane.text is 60ch, inside the band.

rules.title: Balance headings
rules.rule: Headings and titles use text-wrap: balance.

rules.title: No balance on paragraphs
rules.rule: Never use text-wrap: balance on paragraphs.
rules.notes: Issue 15 also bans pretty on long-form; the skill allows pretty on paragraphs. Skill wins (see typo-pretty-body).

rules.title: Pretty paragraphs
rules.rule: Body paragraphs and short descriptions use text-wrap: pretty.

rules.title: Break long strings
rules.rule: Where a long word, URL or ID could escape its container, set overflow-wrap: break-word.

rules.title: Labels do not wrap
rules.rule: Labels and badges that look broken when wrapped use white-space: nowrap.

rules.title: No justify
rules.rule: Interface text is text-align: start; never justify.

rules.title: Tabular numbers
rules.rule: Timers, counters, prices and numeric columns use tabular-nums; prose figures stay proportional.

rules.title: Complete line clamp
rules.rule: -webkit-line-clamp is paired with display: -webkit-box and -webkit-box-orient: vertical.

rules.title: Natural case
rules.rule: Store text in natural case and set case with text-transform.

rules.title: Typographic punctuation
rules.rule: Rendered text uses the ellipsis character, en dashes in ranges and curly quotes; code keeps straight quotes.

rules.title: Tuned underlines
rules.rule: Underlines use from-font position and thickness, or a tuned offset and 1-2px thickness, with skip-ink auto.

rules.title: Skip-ink on
rules.rule: Never set text-decoration-skip-ink: none.

rules.title: Font size floors
rules.rule: Long-form body starts at 16px, UI text about 14px (13px in dense tools), captions 13px, rarely below 12px.
rules.notes: DS micro (11px) sits under the 12px floor: an uppercase micro label warns, other micro text fails. ui-2xs is 12px.

rules.title: rem font sizes
rules.rule: font-size is set in rem so the reader's browser font size applies.
rules.notes: DS font sizes are px except title. Low impact in desktop Electron apps.

rules.title: Smoothing on the root
rules.rule: Set -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased and -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale once on the root.

rules.title: Trim text boxes
rules.rule: In buttons and badges, trim text boxes (text-box: trim-both cap alphabetic) so labels center optically.

rules.title: Content selectable, chrome not
rules.rule: Content text stays selectable; user-select: none only on control chrome and drag surfaces.

rules.title: woff2 fonts
rules.rule: Serve web fonts as woff2.

rules.title: Self-host fonts
rules.rule: Self-host fonts instead of loading them from a third-party CDN.

rules.title: font-display swap
rules.rule: Set font-display: swap with a similar system fallback stack.

rules.title: Readable selection
rules.rule: Style ::selection to match the brand and keep selected text readable.

rules.title: Display and Text cuts
rules.rule: Use a family's Display cut at large sizes and its Text cut at small ones.

rules.title: Emphasis is one weight step
rules.rule: Emphasis within a role is one weight step up, not a size change.

rules.title: Content length
rules.rule: Components survive empty, one-word, several-sentence and one unbreakable 60-character string.

rules.title: Container squeeze
rules.rule: Components survive a narrow container, being squeezed by a sibling, and a very wide container.
rules.notes: Container widths, not viewport (the 320px value is kept as a container test).
